question: Based on our customer pizza order information, summarize the total quantity of each ingredient used in the pizzas we delivered. Output the name and quantity for each ingredient.
sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT order_id 
    FROM pizza_clean_runner_orders 
    WHERE pickup_time IS NOT NULL
),
pizza_items AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT order_id, pizza_id
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders
    WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM delivered_orders)
),
base_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        pi.order_id,
        TRIM(SPLIT_PART(pr.toppings, ',', s.n))::INT as topping_id
    FROM pizza_items pi
    JOIN pizza_recipes pr ON pi.pizza_id = pr.pizza_id
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(GENERATE_SERIES(1, 20)) AS s(n)
    WHERE TRIM(SPLIT_PART(pr.toppings, ',', s.n)) != ''
),
extra_toppings AS (
    SELECT order_id, extras as topping_id, extras_count as quantity
    FROM pizza_get_extras
    WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM delivered_orders)
),
excluded_toppings AS (
    SELECT order_id, exclusions as topping_id, total_exclusions as quantity
    FROM pizza_get_exclusions
    WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM delivered_orders)
),
all_toppings AS (
    SELECT order_id, topping_id, 1 as quantity FROM base_toppings
    UNION ALL
    SELECT order_id, topping_id, quantity FROM extra_toppings
    UNION ALL
    SELECT order_id, topping_id, -quantity FROM excluded_toppings
),
net_toppings AS (
    SELECT order_id, topping_id, SUM(quantity) as net_qty
    FROM all_toppings
    GROUP BY order_id, topping_id
)
SELECT tn.topping_name as name, CAST(SUM(nt.net_qty) AS INTEGER) as quantity
FROM net_toppings nt
JOIN pizza_toppings tn ON nt.topping_id = tn.topping_id
WHERE nt.net_qty > 0
GROUP BY tn.topping_name
ORDER BY tn.topping_name
